description: This file defines a singleton pattern implementation within the WPEFramework Core namespace, including singleton management classes, template classes for singleton instantiation, and proxy support.

classes.name: Singleton
classes.description: Base class for singleton instances, managing registration and lifecycle within a singleton list.

classes.name: SingletonType
classes.description: Template class that implements singleton pattern for a specific type, providing thread-safe instance management and lifecycle control.

classes.name: SingletonProxyType
classes.description: Template class providing singleton access to proxy types, integrating with the singleton pattern.

methods.name: ImplementationName
methods.description: Pure virtual method to return the implementation name of the singleton.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns a reference to the singleton instance, optionally with parameters for construction.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates the singleton instance with optional parameters, if not already created.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the singleton instance, if it exists.
